description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModuleManager, which manages HTML modules within the HTMLPurifier library, including registration, setup, module processing, and retrieving element definitions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModuleManager
classes.description: Manages the registration, setup, and retrieval of HTML modules and element definitions in the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the manager with default doctype registrations and module setup.

methods.name: registerModule
methods.description: Registers a module, either by class name or instance, into the recognized modules list.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a module to the current doctype after registration.

methods.name: addPrefix
methods.description: Adds a class prefix for resolving module class names.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Performs processing on modules based on configuration and prepares element lookup tables.

methods.name: processModule
methods.description: Ensures a module is registered and included in the active modules collection.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Returns merged element definitions from active modules.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves a single merged element definition for a given element name.
